report.explanation: All observed checkout requests returned 200 with durations 78-203ms; p95 checkout latency is 230ms and 502 count is 0. Traces show successful spans across order, inventory, payment, redis and postgres with no errors. Current evidence shows no fault, contradicting a latency/error hypothesis, and is insufficient to substantiate any bounded root cause. Handing off for human review; logs and dependency-level metrics are required before attributing a cause.
missing_evidence: Logs for gateway/order/inventory/payment were excluded (ev-...-gw_logs); needed to identify any error or timeout signatures.
